briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies frontier race as US export controls tighten on advanced chips

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has accelerated with multiple frontier model releases this month. Geopolitical tensions are reshaping compute supply chains while safety concerns mount over uncontrolled agentic systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with major reasoning upgrades. Anthropic launched Claude 4 Opus while Google DeepMind deployed Gemini 3. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 and xAI scaled Grok-3 training on new Memphis supercluster.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped 800k Blackwell GPUs this quarter. Microsoft and Oracle announced joint 5GW data center expansions in Texas and Arizona to support next-gen training runs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls on advanced AI chips meaningfully slow China's frontier progress by 2027?
